title: Rubio: Venezuelan Regime Cooperating to Reduce Chinese Influence | NTD
text:
Secretary of State Marco Rubio told senators on Wednesday that the Venezuelan regime is open to cooperating to counter the influence of China, Russia, and Iran in the South American nation. Democratic and Republican senators agreed with and applauded the Trump administration's execution of operations with absolute resolve to capture Nicolás Maduro.
